component.name: AutoType
component.summary: Voice-typing daemon for Linux Mint XFCE on X11

description.p: AutoType is an open-source, local-first voice typing daemon and assistant designed for Linux Mint XFCE and X11 desktop environments. It features double-tap Right Alt activation, cloud speech-to-text (Deepgram, OpenAI Whisper, Groq, NVIDIA NIM) and offline STT (Parakeet), LLM-assisted text normalization and cleaning, clipboard preservation, and a floating glassmorphic overlay widget with an integrated stop button.
AutoType v1.0.0 official release featuring unified CLI, XDG configuration, multi-backend STT, and pause-resilient dictation.
